generation.continuation: frozen B1; CandidatePoolSampler with zero seed offset; P15 online, R2 loaded, Arm B500, original B1; zero HSI forwards
generation.branch_order: W0,Wplus,Wminus for even state ordinal; Wminus,Wplus,W0 for odd ordinal
generation.rng: Original private HOI seed=(42+task+absolute_window*1000003) modulo(2^63-1), sample_calls=absolute_window. Reset Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA at each branch to42+task; preserve caller RNG. Original snapshots omit ambient RNG; B1 uses private per-window streams, cached future equality checks verify this property.
generation.native_state: Extract original output decode and next-window history preparation into shared functions; original sample_step recomputes nearest path lookahead, progress and conditions. Never splice cached future after a changed candidate.
generation.termination: Original fixed seg_len, no early-goal exit exists. End at min(source_window+3,seg_len); original terminal only at seg_len, otherwise budget_censored. No extension or endpoint-rule change.
generation.scene_cache: Fresh sampler and per-window context/cache per branch; frozen models and immutable dataset arrays shared.

metrics.coarse_frames: Native committed0..13 nonfinal,0..15 original-final; concatenate in common world, every coarse frame once. Include real preceding frame for velocity when available.
metrics.native_fragments: Unchanged interpolation scale3 over retained trajectory; cut synthetic held tail at diagnostic censor, preserve original native held tail only at actual terminal. Compute native-compatible surface HS/OS and per-hand contact on SMPL-X/actual object mesh. Never compare fragment values to whole-task table.
metrics.foot: Native FS formula with unchanged DBSCAN floor estimator on each actual fragment, reported as native-compatible fragment FS cm; no native FS threshold. Separate FK support speed with fixed W0 floor/stance and coverage.
metrics.contact: Fixed current W0 activity and object-local anchor diagnostics plus horizon-matched W0 reference; each branch own predicted contact saved. No valid reference gives N/A. Predicted release/regrasp changes reported ambiguous without instruction-timed evidence.
metrics.task: Human horizontal and object3D endpoint errors cm and progress continuous; full completion only at original terminal, strict errors<10cm.

labels.source: Existing Phase2.21 physical margins reused on actual committed slices; per-hand extension is diagnostic only, frozen before outcomes.
labels.native_FS: continuous only; no transferred full-task threshold
labels.native_HS_OS: benefit requires cumulative native-compatible HS delta<0 and OS delta<=0; each scene proxy protects within original margins
labels.immediate_damage: At least one registered contact/foot/endpoint protection fails in current slice.
labels.delayed_damage: Current protected, at least one subsequent observed slice fails protection.
labels.recovery: Earlier protection failure, final measured subsequent slice protected; retain immediate/delayed flags as well.
labels.beneficial_compatible: Eligible cached-local-guard side, no protection failure across observed slices, cumulative HS<0 and OS<=0, cumulative proxy-scene protections satisfied, and contact evidence adequate. Conditional on measured horizon only.
labels.no_useful_alternative: State has no eligible side satisfying beneficial_compatible, with all available branches evaluated; describe rejected diagnostic branches separately.
labels.ambiguous_or_censored: Missing/failed branch, insufficient active-hand evidence, unresolved predicted activity transition, or horizon censor that prevents requested terminal inference. Two-window valid findings remain available with censor flag.

verification.unit: Snapshot restore, order invariance, sample counters/context/cache isolation, shared native transforms, retained-frame slicing, object3D, N/A/termination/error retention, test-data training rejection.
verification.real: Use first formal state and eligible source-policy future-W0 windows as cached exact replay checks. No extra HOI calls for repeat checks; no standalone smoke. Check native selected current world decode against sealed record and same-state future context/output against sealed W0 when its intervening policy is B1.
verification.authority: pytest tests; tools/experiment.py validate; clean source/resolved configs before manifests
verification.performance: No training microbatch path; synchronized per-window generation/query/metric wall time and GPU allocator peak recorded inside workload.

reporting.unit: 22 states nested in12 tasks and4 scenes; all26 source links retained. State-paired deltas, task means and scene tables; no frame/branch independent-sample CI.
reporting.cost: All candidate and continuation calls, recovery, failed calls, wall/GPU time retained. No current regeneration or extra repeats budgeted.
reporting.decision: Diagnose timing and candidate feasibility; conditional next-protocol drafting only; no training/native28 new policy/441/469.
